findings.description: The code assumes readFileIntoRawString and other helpers succeed; no error handling is present.
Reading the entire file into a std::string without size checks can lead to memory exhaustion on large inputs.
The program includes <regex> and likely applies patterns to untrusted input. Poorly constructed patterns on large inputs can cause catastrophic backtracking and CPU exhaustion.
Calling std::isspace et al. with a possibly signed char is undefined behavior for negative values.
Directly printing untrusted input to console/log without neutralization allows control characters (e.g., ESC, CR, LF) to forge log lines or manipulate terminals.
